title: Programme Gamma holds the largest committed balance
classification: Draft. Unpublished design validation. Synthetic example data, not research.
meta: Synthetic demonstration fixture (currency unit CU, millions)
answer: Programme Gamma carries 640 of the 1,750 CU million committed across seven synthetic programmes; Programme Alpha, the next largest, carries 410. This is a layout fixture and supports no finding about any real programme.

sections.heading: What the exhibit shows
paragraphs: Committed balances are ranked on one measure and one status. Announced and drawn amounts are separate measures and are not combined with them.
Gamma and Alpha together account for 1,050 of 1,750 CU million, so the ranking is concentrated at the top. The remaining five programmes range from 40 to 265.

sections.heading: What it does not show
bullets: Disbursement or physical progress: a committed balance is not a drawn balance.
Any government rationale. Rationale belongs in a separate, quoted record.
Causation. A shared cut-off date does not show that one measure moved another.
